note: Core vocabulary by theme. Each entry: [lemma, BÍN word class, intended English meaning, optional hint]. The hint picks between DMII Core words with the same lemma: a gender (kk, kvk, hk) for nouns, otherwise a form the paradigm must contain; "ET" keeps only the indefinite singular of the paradigm (mars, the month, whose DMII Core paradigm is also mars, a march, with an article and a plural). "indeclinable" marks numerals that do not inflect and are missing from the DMII Core; they are verified in the full BÍN through ylhyra.is instead. The pronouns við and þið are forms of ég and þú, so they are not separate entries. scripts/build-data.mjs checks every lemma against the DMII Core (exists, word class), checks that a Wiktionary gloss contains the intended meaning, and orders by Icelandic Gigaword Corpus frequency. The selection itself needs native review.
